title: Camera+ website, 2012
lede: The site for tap tap tap’s iPhone camera app, archived January 2012: a dark leather-grain page with a gray card, a film strip, and a price tag on a string.
summary: Dark leather grain, a textured gray card, a curling film strip, and a hanging “On sale” tag.

evidence.note: Captured from the Internet Archive with `tools/capture.mjs` (headless Chrome, 1440 × 900) on 28 September 2026 and inspected. The archived page may lack some images or scripts that the live page had.

styles.note: Clear: a leather-grain background, a film strip and a hanging price tag without function, and embossed type on a textured card.

observed: The page background is a very dark gray with a fine pebbled grain like leather.
A large gray card with a paper-like grain and a soft top-lit gradient holds the headline “It’s all about one thing… great photos!” in dark gray with a light lower edge.
A strip of film with sprocket holes curves across the bottom of the card, carrying sample photos.
A green “On sale” tag hangs on a string from a beveled gray “Buy Now” button with a red “99¢” label.
The app icon is a photoreal camera lens in a dark rounded square; an iPhone 4 with a reflection shows the camera screen.
interpretation: It passes the gradient, shadow, and radius metrics (vertical gradients on 15% of boxes, shadows on 82%), but color and surface pattern shares are 0. The measurement sees none of the texture, because the page draws it with bitmap background images; see the style synthesis.
borrow: Hang a small tag on a string from a buy button for a sale price.
Use a curved film strip as a carousel frame for photos.

images.alt: Archived Camera+ page: a dark leather-grain background, a camera-lens app icon, a gray textured card with the headline It’s all about one thing… great photos!, a Buy Now button with a green On sale tag on a string, an iPhone 4 showing the camera, and a curved film strip of photos.
